name: Drum Bus Smash
description: Drums squashed fast, the hits pushed down hard and the room between them lifted, at a little over half its depth.

name: Vocal Up Front
description: A voice's body held even and its quiet words lifted, its top pushed only gently: closer, steadier, never harsh.

name: Air and Detail
description: Mostly lifting, and mostly in the top: breaths, noise and the tails of notes brought up, the hits hardly touched.

name: All the Way
description: Every band pushed down and lifted at full depth: the loud and the quiet brought to one level in each band, the dense, bright, in-your-face sound of a synth or a drop run through it.

name: Bass Thickener
description: A bass held to one level from its lows to its growl, the top left alone: every note as loud as the next, its harmonics brought forward.

name: Half Tide
description: The same at half its depth, under what came in: more detail and sheen without losing the hits' shape.

name: Lift Only
description: Nothing pushed down, only the quiet lifted, at half its depth: tails, reverb and sustain brought up under the notes, the attacks as they were.

name: Pad Glow
description: Slow and soft: a pad's movement evened out over a long time, its quiet parts glowing up between the chords.
